title: Strict balancing comparison of quotient total tensor towers
statement: Let C be a small site and A any commutative ring, I an ideal. Write B for the inverse limit of the constant quotient sheaves B_n=A/I^(n+1), with projection pi_n and quotient transitions [def-sfb-constant-completion-coefficient-data]. Use actual sheafified scalar extension and direct-sum total tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Suppose tau_n is a natural chain map from the restricted tensor of the two pi_(n+1)-extensions to the analogous n-th tensor, taking (a tensor x) tensor (b tensor y) to (q(a) tensor x) tensor (q(b) tensor y). For arbitrary unbounded complexes P,Q of B-modules, the reduction tower of Tot(P tensor_B Q) [def-pur-strict-quotient-completion-data] is isomorphic as a strict tower of complexes to the tower formed using tau. Its component takes c tensor (x tensor y) in bidegree (p,q), p+q=k, to (1 tensor x) tensor (c tensor y). No flatness, Noetherian or boundedness assumption is required. The Lean interface retains a complex V with an isomorphism b from the reduction complex and a tower isomorphism from V.asFunctor; the displayed formula is for kappa composed with b. One may take V equal to the reduction complex and b equal to its identity.

proof.text: Apply lem-sf-normalized-finite-tensor-comparison at every n to obtain the finite scalar total-tensor isomorphism e_n. It sends (a*b) tensor (x tensor y) to (a tensor x) tensor (b tensor y). Additivity of the actual reduction functors follows from their extension/restriction composition.

proof.text: For a successor map, compare reductionStep followed by e_n with e_(n+1) followed by the given tau_n. The generic total_extension_hom_ext of lem-pur-integral-tensor-transition-compatibility reduces equality degreewise to c tensor (x tensor y). The reductionStep section formula and the two normalizations show that both paths give (1 tensor x) tensor (q(c) tensor y).

proof.text: Use NatTrans.ofOpSequence with components e_n to construct the tower natural transformation. The successor calculation gives naturality; its components are isomorphisms, so it is an isomorphism. Take V to be the original reduction complex and b its identity. The normalization follows from the finite-level formula with scalar factors 1 and c.

theorem quotientTotalTensorTowerComparison
    (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, (((change (projection J A I (n + 1))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
        ((change (projection J A I (n + 1))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙
      coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u, u} J (finite J A I (n + 1)) ⋙
        (res (projection J A I (n + 1))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⟶
      (((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
        ((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙
      coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u, u} J (finite J A I n) ⋙
        (res (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)))
    (hτ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (P Q : Cx (completed J A I))
      (p q k : ℤ) (h : p + q = k) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
      (a b : (finite J A I (n + 1)).obj.obj U)
      (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj U),
      (((τ n).app (P, Q)).f k).val.app U
        (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u, u} J (finite J A I (n + 1))
          (((change (projection J A I (n + 1))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((change (projection J A I (n + 1))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
          p q k h U
          (tensorSection (projection J A I (n + 1)) (P.X p) U a x)
            (tensorSection (projection J A I (n + 1)) (Q.X q) U b y)) =
        coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u, u} J (finite J A I n)
          (((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
          p q k h U
          (tensorSection (projection J A I n) (P.X p) U ((transition J A I n).hom.app U a) x)
            (tensorSection (projection J A I n) (Q.X q) U ((transition J A I n).hom.app U b) y))
    (P Q : Cx (completed J A I)) :
    ∃ (V : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Mod (completed J A I)) ℤ)
      (b : reductionComplex J A I true
        ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u, u} J (completed J A I)).obj (P, Q)) ≅ V)
      (κ : V.asFunctor ≅
      (Functor.ofOpSequence (X := fun n : ℕ ↦
        (((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
        ((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙
      coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u, u} J (finite J A I n) ⋙
        (res (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) τ).flip.obj (P, Q)),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (p q k : ℤ) (h : p + q = k) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
        (c : (finite J A I n).obj.obj U)
        (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj U),
        ((κ.hom.app (op n)).f k).val.app U
          (((b.hom.f k).app (op n)).val.app U
            (tensorSection (projection J A I n)
            (((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u, u} J (completed J A I)).obj (P, Q)).X k) U c
            (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u, u} J (completed J A I)
              P Q p q k h U x y))) =
          coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u, u} J (finite J A I n)
          (((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((change (projection J A I n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
          p q k h U
          (tensorSection (projection J A I n) (P.X p) U 1 x)
            (tensorSection (projection J A I n) (Q.X q) U c y)
